violations.text: Observed hand-washing sink not setup at temp. event and lacking soap and paper towel. PIC setup spigot with water, soap and paper towel. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap and a drying agent. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/21/2026

The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the (chlorine) sanitizing solution for the (3-bay bins at temp. event). Mobile lacked sanitization setup. PIC setup up sanitizer station and obtain test strips at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/21/2026
